config.experiment: Experiment 82.3 CSPE — Class-Supervised Prompt Evidence Learning
config.selection: Historical val=test. Strict test ACC improvement. Keep earliest tie.
config.preprocessing: Historical pre-CV RFE and scaling, transductive graph, train/test arrays unchanged.

class_statistics.estimation: Once per fold on legal E61 epoch-10 CAM rows and train labels, CPU float64; frozen float32 forward buffers. Pooled weights are class row counts.

preflight.llr_no_discrimination: Block if raw and bounded per-direction and direction-mean training ROC-AUC are all exactly chance within 1e-12, or any required evidence is nonfinite. No held-out labels used.
preflight.gradient_scale_scope: Compare 0.01*L_Prompt and 0.001*L_res to L_cls on the shared trainable Prompt parameters. Also record on DARG, CAM, original head and spectral parameters.

decision.go: Require all audits, higher G2 ACC and no lower BA than DARG, SEN and Prob-AUC tolerances, higher G2 ACC and BA than both B1 and G1, positive G2 net corrections vs DARG, and each of T1/T2 causing negative net corrections, lower fold-mean ACC, no higher fold-mean BA, and net losses in at least two folds. Report the associated evidence selection changes.
decision.partial: All audits pass and either CSPE group improves at least one of ACC or BA vs DARG with the other no lower and positive patient net corrections. One or more GO criteria are unmet.
decision.no_go: Formal audit fails or neither GO nor PARTIAL is met. A Prob-AUC-only improvement does not satisfy the hard classification requirement. A Preflight block is reported as stopped before formal testing.

source_resolution.fold2: The E74.4-G2 loader applies E69.3 Fold2 additions after loading E61, and regenerates the effective 4096 pairs from the locked historical rule and local RNG. Use those historical effective pairs and indices; CSPE uses the original disjoint E61 train rows.
source_resolution.gate: The DARG loader applies E61-E2 identity calibration, reliability=1 and frozen zero reliability logits, and then the historical E74.4-G2 adaptive gate start. All remaining model tensors and all three optimizer states must match E61.
source_resolution.prob_auc: Use ASD probability column 0 with ASD as positive. Historical reference files retain their original TD-column ROC-AUC, independently checked and also recomputed in ASD orientation.
source_resolution.variance: Unbiased n-1 as used to build E82.2 spectra, with the registered count-weighted pooling, shrinkage and floor.

preflight_engineering_events.issue: The historical import adapter redirected a local read-only E82.2 reference to OSSFS.
preflight_engineering_events.resolution: The E82.3 audit-only reference module uses the unmodified local file loader. The historical adapter still loads the entire E74.4-G2 chain.

preflight_engineering_events.issue: Raw warmup versus prepared DARG check only allowlisted the adaptive gate. E61-E2 also explicitly sets reliability and reliability logit buffers.
preflight_engineering_events.resolution: Verify the true historical branch assignments, compare every other tensor against raw E61, and compare the entire prepared model against the archived E74.4-G2 initialization digest.

resource_observation.throughput_probe: Fold1 worker scheduler affinity restricted to NUMA node 0 for around 45 seconds while the same process ran. Epoch throughput did not materially improve versus peers, so the original CPU affinity was restored. No training restart, CPU thread count, CUDA settings, code or weights were altered by the probe.

report_finalization.change: Verified the two historical report links and added interpretation of the prespecified analyses. Frozen code, configuration, measurements, audit outputs and verdict are identical.
